decisions.reason: A safety shoe line sits at the core of the firm's in-house manufacturing and development knowledge, so management can readily interpret early results and refine it.
A comfort insole is closely related to the firm's footwear and foot-measurement expertise, though as a simple accessory it is somewhat more exposed to range consolidation.
A supportive insole builds on the firm's ergonomic and orthopaedic footwear knowledge, letting it learn from use, though overlap with the other insoles poses some risk.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has its own page and draws directly on the firm's core development and production capabilities, which favours continued refinement.
Firefighter boots are a specialised but adjacent protective footwear segment where the firm's materials and manufacturing knowledge still let it assimilate market feedback.
The moulded insole is shown on the home page as a flagship and links the firm's foot-measurement tools with its footwear expertise, so it is strongly positioned to be developed further.
